tools.name: score_cv_ats
tools.title: Score CV for ATS
tools.description: Score a plain-text CV/résumé out of 100 for ATS (applicant tracking system) friendliness and return the failed checks with concrete improvement hints.

cv_text.description: The full CV/résumé as plain text.

tools.name: match_cv_to_job
tools.title: Match CV to job posting
tools.description: Compare a plain-text CV against a job posting and report keyword coverage: match percentage, matched keywords and missing keywords worth addressing.

cv_text.description: The full CV/résumé as plain text.

job_posting.description: The job posting / vacancy text to compare against.

keyword_limit.description: How many of the posting's top keywords to compare. Sensible range 10-60, default 30.

tools.name: tidy_cv_text
tools.title: Tidy CV text
tools.description: Clean up CV/résumé text formatting: normalize bullet characters, collapse extra spaces and blank lines, fix punctuation spacing and prefix bare links with https://. Returns the cleaned text and a list of what changed.

cv_text.description: The CV/résumé text to tidy up.
